title: cicerbita decipiens
intro: Cicerbita decipiens, commonly known as Alpine Hawk's Beard, is a flowering plant that belongs to the dandelion family (Asteraceae). It is a perennial herb that has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include treating digestive issues, inflammation, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Cicerbita decipiens include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and expectorant properties, which can help to alleviate symptoms of colds, coughs, and fever. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
